growthStage.title: Growth stages

carePlanData.disclaimer: Recommendations from 2008 (organic farming), not a regulation. Check products and limits against current legislation.
carePlanData.source: FiBL / Bioinstitut, Ochrana révy vinné v ekologickém vinohradnictví před hlavními chorobami a škůdci (Czech edition), pp. 2–3, 6–7, 11–12.
carePlanData.note: FiBL / Bioinstitut organic plan, Czech adaptation 12/2007. Products, doses and limits are from 2008.

stages.woollyBud: Woolly bud to first green tip

mites_calepitrimerus_spring.description: Check for grape rust mites at budbreak (B–D). Larvae hatch 8–10 days after budbreak.
mites_calepitrimerus_spring.threshold: An average of about 90 mites per leaf at budbreak (indicative).

mites_calepitrimerus_late.threshold: About 170 mites per leaf at the end of summer (indicative).

mites_eriophyes_spring.description: At budbreak, check mainly the older lower leaves. The erineum mite has up to 7 generations.

mites_eriophyes_late.description: In late summer (veraison), mark vines with repeated heavy infestation. Treat them in spring before budbreak.

phomopsis_b.description: Check around B (01). Remove infected wood and treat the wounds with balm.

powdery_e.description: Check for powdery mildew at E (3–4 leaves). Infection occurs at humidity above 80%; leaf wetness is not required.

moth_generation_1.description: 1st moth generation: check with pheromone traps between H and I. Caterpillars hatch about 7 days after egg laying.
moth_generation_1.threshold: There is no numeric threshold. Temperatures above 12–15 °C increase caterpillar activity.

moth_generation_2.description: 2nd moth generation: check around J (73). Caterpillars enter the berries within 4–6 days.

spider_mite_panonychus_dormant.description: Check the wood during pruning for eggs at the bud bases. Direct protection is neither necessary nor possible.
spider_mite_panonychus_dormant.threshold: More than 80% of bud bases with eggs.

spider_mite_panonychus_leaves.description: Check the leaves at the 3-leaf stage (E).
spider_mite_panonychus_leaves.threshold: More than 70% of leaves occupied at E.

spider_mite_tetranychus.description: Check the leaves for mites from May to July.
spider_mite_tetranychus.threshold: May–June: 30–40% of leaves with mites; July–August: 20–30%. Direct protection is not possible in organic viticulture.
spider_mite_tetranychus.note: The book gives calendar months (May–July), not BBCH. The BBCH range is approximate.

leafhopper_yellow_traps.description: Yellow sticky traps at stages F–H. Check the leaves for larvae.

leafhopper_generation_1.description: 1st generation: check the leaves for larvae at stage I.
leafhopper_generation_1.threshold: 4–5 larvae per leaf at stage I (1st generation). Direct protection is usually not necessary.

leafhopper_generation_2.description: 2nd generation: check the leaves for larvae at stage L.
leafhopper_generation_2.threshold: 4–5 larvae per leaf at stage L (2nd generation). Direct protection is usually not necessary.
